name: streptomyces_coverage_dropout
mechanism: Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2) has a genomic GC content of approximately 72%, among the highest of any sequenced bacterium. Standard Illumina library preparation introduces GC-dependent amplification bias: GC-rich fragments are underrepresented after PCR because the high melting temperature of GC-rich duplexes causes uneven denaturation and extension. The result is systematic coverage dropout at GC-rich loci throughout the genome. Because Streptomyces secondary metabolite biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) are typically concentrated in the GC-rich chromosomal arms, coverage dropout disproportionately affects the most biologically important regions. Assemblers receive sparse k-mer coverage in dropout regions: the de Bruijn graph is disconnected at these loci, producing assembly breaks. The assembled genome appears normal by aggregate statistics (N50, total length) but is missing genes in GC-rich regions. No assembler flags this — the assembly simply stops at dropout boundaries.

known_behaviors.behavior: Assembly breaks at GC-rich coverage dropout regions. Secondary metabolite biosynthetic gene clusters in the chromosomal arms are frequently fragmented or absent. The chromosome is assembled in many contigs rather than approaching the true 1-contig chromosome + 2 plasmids. Exit 0.

Low-coverage regions (GC dropout) produce coverage valleys in per-base depth analysis. Variant calling at these positions fails silently due to insufficient depth. No MAPQ or alignment-score warning about GC bias — it is invisible at the per-read level.

Flags 'Per Sequence GC Content' as FAIL because the 72% GC distribution does not match FastQC's expected normal distribution centred at ~45%. This is a correct detection, but automated pipelines that gate on this FAIL may reject valid data.

samples.description: Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2) Illumina PAIRED WGS reads (PRJEB3084). Reference genome GCF_000203835.1 is 9.05 Mb, 72.1% GC, complete chromosome + 2 plasmids.

download.command: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir . ERR16938122 && mv ERR16938122_1.fastq.gz reads_1.fq.gz && mv ERR16938122_2.fastq.gz reads_2.fq.gz

ground_truth.note: GC dropout is expected to disproportionately affect the ~12 secondary metabolite biosynthetic gene clusters in the chromosomal arms. Detection: compute per-position GC content vs. per-position coverage from the aligned BAM. Coverage should show negative correlation with local GC content.

curation.notes: PRJEB3084 is a well-characterized Streptomyces coelicolor sequencing project. ERR16938122 has 1.56M read pairs, giving ~52x mean coverage over the 9.05Mb genome — sufficient to demonstrate the coverage dropout pattern without the confound of globally insufficient depth.
